text_block_list.name: Spe & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Let's all take good care of our grandparents!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Let's do it! Check it, rack it, oh yeah!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why should we treat them gently?
Just 'cause it's Respect for the Aged Day doesn't mean might makes right, does it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Respect for the Aged Day is all about thanking our elders and ancestors!
Dad always says, "Blood ties are important," after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then let's each find someone we feel a connection with
and do something nice for them!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, the light won't change~!
I'm gonna be so, so late at this rate~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, are you waiting for the light to change?
Let me carry your bags for you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Forget the luggage for a second and come with me,
Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo, a 5-hour karaoke marathon♪
Spe-chan on vocals, and me as the backup performer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!?
Even though you're older, you're more energetic than me~ !?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bakushin O-san!
If there's anything troubling you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kita-san!
Huh? What on earth am I doing here?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that just Bakushin?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that's right!
Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait up—! Bakushin O,
weren't you just bakushin-ing a moment ago~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, McQueen! If your shoulders are stiff,
a dropkick should fix 'em right up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That won't be necessary!
At least pretend to be kind!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All the people we shared a connection with
seemed to be doing wonderfully, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, when it comes to pampering,
let's stick to a real grandma!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! While doing handstands in the downtown district, we'll find another target...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I will not let you do that, Gold Ship-san! I won't allow you to rampage any further!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaah, McQ-fiend, McQ-fiend has appeared!
This village is dooooomed!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, Golshi-san
feels the most like an ancestor.
